product_overview: PMIMS is a Sharia-compliant precious metals inventory ledger for tracking serialized gold and silver bars across vault coordinate grids. It supports role-based access, maker-checker approvals, and operational workflows for inventory movement, custody, auditing, and reporting.
core_goals: Authenticate into the system using valid credentials
Review treasury inventory and pending authorizations from a central dashboard
Locate stored bars using the vault zone, shelf, and slot map
Create and approve procurement orders for precious metals
Create and approve inventory transfers between vaults
Manage customer custody records and gold bar withdrawals
Perform stocktake activities and reconcile physical inventory
Use the AI copilot to query treasury and inventory information
Manage system settings and administrative access

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Users sign in with mock Active Directory credentials and can switch between English and Arabic before entering the application.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Fill in username -> Fill in password -> Select interface language -> Submit sign-in form -> See dashboard
Navigate to / -> Fill in username -> Fill in password -> Submit sign-in form with invalid credentials -> See validation errors

features.name: Treasury Dashboard
features.description: Users view an overview of stock holdings, inventory value, and pending authorizations after signing in.
user_flows: Sign in successfully -> Navigate to /dashboard -> Review stock summary metrics -> Review pending authorization counts

features.name: Spatial Vault Map
features.description: Users explore an interactive map of vault zones, shelves, and slots to locate serialized bar inventory.
user_flows: Navigate to /spatial-map -> View vault zones grid -> Select a zone -> View shelves within the zone -> Select a shelf -> View slots within the shelf -> Select a slot -> View bar inventory details

features.name: Procurement Workflow
features.description: Makers create precious metals procurement orders and checkers approve or reject pending requests.
user_flows: Navigate to /procurement -> Start a new procurement order -> Enter supplier details -> Enter bar quantity -> Enter metal type and purity -> Enter weight and serial numbers -> Submit the order for verification -> See the request added to pending procurement items
Navigate to /procurement -> Open a pending procurement request -> Approve the request -> See the procurement status updated
Navigate to /procurement -> Open a pending procurement request -> Reject the request -> See the procurement status updated

features.name: Inventory Transfers
features.description: Makers request bar transfers between vaults and checkers approve or reject the pending transfer request.
user_flows: Navigate to /transfers -> Start a new transfer request -> Select the source vault -> Select the destination vault -> Select bars to transfer -> Submit the request for approval -> See the request added to pending transfers
Navigate to /transfers -> Open a pending transfer request -> Approve the request -> See the transfer status updated
Navigate to /transfers -> Open a pending transfer request -> Reject the request -> See the transfer status updated

features.name: Custody Management
features.description: Users manage customer custody records and track bars held on behalf of customers.
user_flows: Navigate to /custody -> Review customer custody records -> Open a custody record -> Review associated bar tracking details -> Update custody information

features.name: Customer Withdrawals
features.description: Users process customer gold bar withdrawals and release bars from custody.
user_flows: Navigate to /withdrawals -> Start a new withdrawal request -> Select the customer and bars to withdraw -> Submit the withdrawal request -> See the withdrawal recorded

features.name: Stocktake and Audits
features.description: Users perform physical inventory stocktakes and compare audited stock with recorded inventory.
user_flows: Navigate to /stocktake -> Start a stocktake session -> Review counted bars by location -> Record audit results -> Complete the stocktake

features.name: Reporting
features.description: Users review valuation and stock reports and export inventory information.
user_flows: Navigate to /reports -> Open a valuation report -> Review inventory value details -> Open a stock report -> Review stock movement and balance details -> Export the report data

features.name: AI Copilot
features.description: Users ask natural-language questions about inventory and treasury data and receive assistance from the copilot.
user_flows: Navigate to /copilot -> Enter a natural-language question -> Submit the query -> Review the copilot response

features.name: System Settings
features.description: Users adjust application-level configuration options from the settings page.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> Review available configuration options -> Update a setting -> Save changes

features.name: Admin Setup
features.description: Administrators manage users, groups, and permissions from the admin page.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> Review existing users, groups, and permissions -> Create or edit an access control entry -> Save the administrative changes
